request.description:
Submit in-app forms from authenticated users. Use this for:
- Support request forms within your app
- Feedback forms
- Help center contact forms
- User-initiated inquiries

Requires JWT authentication (logged-in user).

Compatibility adapter for legacy systems that can't generate HMAC signatures.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This endpoint is less secure. Use the main /intake endpoint when possible.

The shim automatically:
1. Accepts simple JSON or form data
2. Generates HMAC signature
3. Forwards to /intake with proper auth

Requires INTAKE_TOKEN environment variable on server.

request.description:
✅ External forms use /intake endpoint (NOT /forms/submit)
✅ Works from any domain (no cookies)
✅ Uses intake token + HMAC auth

Configure Typeform webhook:
1. Form Settings → Integrations → Webhooks
2. URL: https://api.kalevent.com/api/v1/intake
3. Add custom headers (see Headers tab)
4. Map form fields to body
